CISF Personnel Suspended After Photo Allegations on Delhi Metro

A Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel was suspended and an inquiry ordered after a woman alleged he secretly photographed her inside a Delhi Metro train near AIIMS. A video of the incident, showing passengers confronting the official, went viral on social media. The CISF stated the personnel was suspended immediately. Police reported that the woman did not file a formal complaint.
